composition_subtypes.role: Sort flights by day for forward and backward processing
Maintain minimum cost per city using sorted order
Pair forward and backward lists to minimize total cost

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort flights by day; greedily compute min cost per city over time; two-pointer merge to find optimal arrival/departure pair.
payload.rationale: Code sorts flights with custom key, accumulates cheapest costs per city as days progress, then uses two pointers to match forward and backward lists with required day gap.
